scope: Independent disk-only code review and offline tests; no live calls or source edits by reviewer.
finding: No blocking correctness issue found in the reviewed source state.
checks: Stable queue mutex inode is never unlinked.
Ticket creation and ownership flock occur under the mutex; crash before ownership leaves a pruneable unlocked ticket.
Only the oldest registered live ticket may claim numbered capacity slots.
Liveness probes use flock rather than PID or wall-clock expiry.
Owner cleanup unlinks its UUID path while retaining its lease lock; scans tolerate disappearance.
Capacity waits release the metadata mutex; all configured slots can run concurrently.
Cancellation and deadline races close a claimed slot and remove the owner ticket.
Brief mutex contention retries at 1ms; unavailable capacity waits at 50ms.
The two old-source RED tests reproduce late-before-older admission in threads and spawned processes.
limits: FIFO orders successful registration under queue.lock, not wall-clock invocation start.
Polling on the short metadata guard is not itself a formal starvation-free mutex.
FIFO does not guarantee deadlines under overload or externally held slots.
All participating processes should use the same slot limit and scheduler generation.

independent_test_runs.source_state: Before changing only metadata-mutex contention sleep from 50ms to 1ms
